references.text: Describes the pillars of the courtyard with their hooks and bands of silver, which is the same as mentioned in Exodus 38:28
Refers to gold hooks for the pillars, showing a similar construction technique for the tabernacle's pillars
Describes the pillars of the courtyard with hooks and bands of silver, directly related to the use of silver mentioned in verse 28
Mentions that the pillars of the courtyard had hooks and bands of silver, and that the capitals were overlaid with silver—the same work described in verse 28
Refers to four pillars with silver-overlaid capitals and hooks and bands of silver, which is the same work done with the silver in verse 28
Describes the same construction steps: the preparation (36:38) and the final use of the materials (38:28) for the entrance pillars.
